_about: One list of the other names people use for each tool. scripts/chrome.cjs reads it: `k` and `aka` go into the menu (data-k), where assets/nav.js turns them into site search and /tools search; `aka` is also shown on the tool page (ap-aka region) and written into its SoftwareApplication schema as alternateName and keywords. Only names that really describe the tool: no brands we are not, no tools we do not have. A new tool in the menu needs an entry here or the build check fails.
